title: Even in limited capacity, Malik Nabers brings 'aura' as Giants open training camp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Even in limited capacity, Malik Nabers brings 'aura' as Giants open training camp
sources.description: Confidence that Malik Nabers would return for the start of the 2026-27 season had waned in the months since his injury. But seeing Nabers with his quarterback, hours after he took part in individual drills, changed that outlook.
